label: Thermal Infrared

traits.texture: smooth nested color zones with soft sensor-like halos and gently reduced detail
traits.composition: map the reference value masses into separate false-color bands while retaining recognizable silhouettes
traits.lighting: luminous warm focal zones against cooler blue and violet surroundings

review_checks: False-color zones are distinct and intentional
Horizon and major silhouettes remain recognizable
There are no invented temperature readings or measurement overlays
limitations: False colors are artistic choices; ordinary photographs do not establish temperature, emissivity or measured infrared radiation.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
